children: unveiled its second limited-edition collection of apparel and accessories in partnership with Realtree.

The motorcycle company said the collection is for riders and hunters who live in both worlds. The Harley-Davidson x Realtree collection was highlighted as pairing Realtree's iconic camouflage with Harley-Davidson's
signature styles. Building on the first collection, the latest drop expands the assortment with new styles, including cargo pants, vests, work shirts, and more.
Apparel is a meaningful but small component of Harley-Davidson's

overall business, consisting of roughly 5% of the company’s reported revenue. Apparel rose 1.5% in the second quarter and 0.7% in the first half, which was better than the decline in HOG's parts and accessories business over the same quarter.

title: Harley-Davidson unveils new limited-edition apparel collection
